02_itemised_bill.pdf.title: One admission split into two invoices under the approval threshold
02_itemised_bill.pdf.what_changed_and_where: Pages 1-2: one admission billed as two invoices with different Bill Nos. but the same IP No. Each is under ₹2,00,000; together ₹3,41,500.
02_itemised_bill.pdf.attack_goal: Keep each invoice under the ₹2,00,000 senior-approval threshold.
detection_signals: Same IP number, UHID and dates on both invoices
02_itemised_bill.pdf.notes: Both totals are honest and the combined total is within tariff. Only the routing is wrong.

03_settlement_letter.pdf.title: Split invoices assessed together and paid correctly
03_settlement_letter.pdf.what_changed_and_where: Both invoices of the split admission assessed together (₹3,41,500). Only the 5% co-pay deducted.
03_settlement_letter.pdf.attack_goal: None. Tests that ClaimClear reads both invoices as one claim.
03_settlement_letter.pdf.notes: The claimed amount is the sum of both invoices. Tools that settle one invoice at a time will undercount.
